wp_parent:
CREATE TABLE `wp_parent` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `code` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `code` (`code`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
wp_child;x:
CREATE TABLE `wp_child;x` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `parent_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `parent_code` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `qty` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'a; b ''c'' REFERENCES `wp_parent`',
  `total` int GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((`qty` * 2)) VIRTUAL,
  `total2` int GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((`qty` + 1)) STORED,
  `meta` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` text,
  `pt` point NOT NULL,
  `created` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `parent` (`parent_id`),
  KEY `title_prefix` (`title`(20)),
  SPATIAL KEY `sp` (`pt`),
  KEY `parent_code` (`parent_code`),
  FULLTEXT KEY `ft` (`title`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_child_parent` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_id`) REFERENCES `wp_parent` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `wp_child;x_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_code`) REFERENCES `wp_parent` (`code`),
  CONSTRAINT `qty_positive` CHECK ((`qty` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `wp_child;x_chk_1` CHECK ((`qty` < 1000000))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='x;y'
wp_part:
CREATE TABLE `wp_part` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `d` date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`,`d`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
/*!50100 PARTITION BY RANGE (year(`d`))
(PARTITION p0 VALUES LESS THAN (2020) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION p1 VALUES LESS THAN MAXVALUE ENGINE = InnoDB) */
wp_inv:
CREATE TABLE `wp_inv` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
